integrity: The proof counts the left and right annihilator subspaces of a rank-r matrix and their intersection, then independently counts square-zero rank-r matrices by image-kernel flags. Direct finite-field graph construction is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the underlying simple zero-divisor graph of full matrix rings over finite fields and is stated for dimensions at least three.
It does not determine the full automorphism group, adjacency spectrum, or a global isomorphism classification.
It does not assert that the degree multiset alone reconstructs the parameters of the matrix ring.
title: Degree strata recover rank and square-zero type in matrix zero-divisor graphs
